verdict.rationale: Daytona's SDK docs (Python/TypeScript) are described as a general interface for programmatically interacting with sandboxes, and volume docs mention shared file access ('read from large files instantly - no need to upload files manually'), implying some file I/O capability, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents dedicated SDK methods for reading, writing, uploading, or downloading individual files in the sandbox filesystem. missing for 10: explicit SDK fs.read_file/write_file/upload_file/download_file API documentation, code examples showing file upload/download via SDK, independent confirmation of these operations working.
